name: Agate 30
notes: Billowy agate wash: three coarse fat vein octaves under a strong flow warp. Stroke-tested pre-promotion: no characteristic-frequency bump, no comb. Dual-gate architecture (docs/fractal-texture-math.md par.9): the mask multiplies the finished stroke once, so its structure survives the paint train; canvas-anchored delivery was considered for the damage textures and rejected in review in favour of dual-gating everything. Tips synthesized and calibrated from tips/agate.spec.json (levels 30/55/80 = core-band stroke coverage); spectral verification by tools/spectrum-audit.mjs. Thin liquid wisps.
